counterfactual_boundary: Decision probe only; stops at first changed ownership. No physics or PD stability claim.

constants.entry_ramp_rule: u = smoothstep((t - t_entry) / entry_ramp_s); Kp = Kp0 + (HOLD_KP - Kp0) u; Kd = Kd0 + (HOLD_KD - Kd0) u; target = q0 + (Kp0 / Kp) (T0 - q0); q0, T0, Kp0, Kd0 = joint_pos, applied_target, applied_kp, applied_kd at entry (PRD D4)

entry_kd_modes.step1: Kd = HOLD_KD from the entry step on
entry_kd_modes.step2p5: Kd = entry_landing_kd from the entry step until entry_ramp_s, then entry_landing_kd + (HOLD_KD - entry_landing_kd) smoothstep((t - t_entry - entry_ramp_s) / (transition_s - entry_ramp_s)); exactly HOLD_KD from FIXED_STAND on
entry_kd_modes.xfade1s: crossfade entry over 1.0 s (entry_crossfade_rule); Kd = HOLD_KD from the entry step on
entry_kd_modes.xfade2s: crossfade entry over 2.0 s (entry_crossfade_rule); Kd = HOLD_KD from the entry step on
entry_kd_modes.precedent: MJ BOOT_LANDING_KD 2.5 over FIXED_STAND_BOOT_GRACE_S 1.0 s (PRD D5)

constants.entry_crossfade_rule: w = smoothstep((t - t_entry) / T_x); Kp = (1 - w) Kp0 + w HOLD_KP; target = ((1 - w) Kp0 P + w HOLD_KP H) / Kp; Kd = HOLD_KD from the entry step on; P = this step's policy target, H = the torque-matched seed at entry, Kp0 = applied_kp at entry; w = 0 gives P with Kp0; t - t_entry >= T_x gives exactly H with HOLD_KP and HOLD_KD (PRD D6)
constants.entry_grace_rule: automatic arming (RL -> STAND_SETTLING) needs now_s >= entry_grace_s (episode sim time) for the listed variants; before that the mode stays RL with reason entry_grace (PRD D6; precedent MJ FIXED_STAND_BOOT_GRACE_S 1.0 s)
